sn12.17:2.2: “I’d like to ask the worthy Gotama about a certain point, if you’d take the time to answer.”
sn12.17:4.2: When asked ‘then, worthy Gotama, is suffering made by another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.17:4.3: When asked ‘well, worthy Gotama, is suffering made by both oneself and another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.17:4.4: When asked ‘then, worthy Gotama, does suffering arise anomalously, not made by oneself or another’, you say ‘not so’.
sn12.17:4.6: When asked ‘then does the worthy Gotama not know or see suffering’, you say ‘it’s not that I don’t know or see suffering.
